summary: Visual QA of redesigned public landing page at desktop (1440) and mobile (390). All acceptance criteria satisfied: hero card content is fully visible with no overlap from the floating shield badge; bento grid renders with the dominant 587x493 'Verified-only membership' feature tile, a dark 'Undercover-safe privacy' tile, and a full-width 118px 'Safe exchange guidance' gold tile; all 6 differentiators present with exact copy; story reel shows 6 tall cards with real thumbnails (all naturalWidth > 0), LIVE badge on the first card, and hover play-glyph scales (0.9 -> 1.08); hero turnout-gear image loads (1024w). Reveal elements all reach opacity 1 after scroll. No console/page errors (only expected /api/auth/me 401 filtered). Reduced-motion emulation removes reveal transitions. Mobile shows single-column bento (342px), badge stays within viewport, and no horizontal page overflow (scrollWidth == clientWidth == 390). All original data-testids and link targets are unchanged (landing-signin-btn -> /login, landing-join-btn/hero-join-btn/cta-start-btn -> /register).
critical_code_review_comments: Landing.jsx uses inline styles on the full-width gold bento tile (gridColumn '1 / -1' + flex overrides). Fine functionally, but consider moving to a .bento.gold.full CSS class for consistency and easier maintenance.

Story reel thumbnails hit Pexels/Unsplash CDNs directly with no lazy-loading or fallback; if CDN blips these become broken tiles. Consider preloading or a solid navy placeholder background-color on .thumb.

prefers-reduced-motion is respected for .reveal transitions, but the framer-motion hero animations in Landing.jsx (initial/animate props) run regardless. Consider gating them with useReducedMotion() for full parity.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 4 covered visual redesign QA of / (public landing) only. Auth/verification/admin flows were already green in iterations 1-3 and were not re-tested. Screenshots for desktop and mobile are in /app/test_reports/screens/. Bento tile dimensions confirmed: feature 587x493, standard tiles 285x237, gold full-width 1192x118. Hero shield badge at (1280,186,52x52) does not overlap item name/price/seller strip. Mobile grid collapses to single 342px column, no horizontal overflow at 390px.
